sentence: The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room restates in the model's terms: flag building (P01-P04), neighbour-sparing and borders (P07/P08/P16/P19), defense (P05/P14), close (P11-P13), April Fools humour (K01), and prior quarrels (K03); its unused concepts on visibility, cohabitation, hostility judgments and jokes show nothing the model lacks or contradicts.
